criteria.statement: The Compose Deploy dialog is a stepwise wizard covering target, immutable artifact, service/process configuration, literal environment, secret references, healthcheck, restart, volumes, resources, policy, and cost.
An operator can assemble an Arcana-ready port 8080 and GET /healthz desired state without Arcana-specific generic defaults.
The exact backend-canonical non-secret desired state, current-to-proposed diff, and hash are displayed, and service/deploy signs that same hash.
Only registered full SHA-256 artifact digests and opaque secret references are accepted; secret values never enter the desired-state payload.
Submission is signer-first, idempotent, rejects stale reviewed hashes, and routes through existing policy and approval handling.
